title: Traslocare: le collocazioni del trasloco e i piani per il futuro

sentences.it: Questo weekend impacchettiamo gli scatoloni della cucina.
sentences.en: We're packing the kitchen boxes this weekend.
alternatives: We are packing the kitchen boxes this weekend.
This weekend we're packing the kitchen boxes.
This weekend we are packing the kitchen boxes.
sentences.hint: present continuous per un programma — pack, kitchen boxes, this weekend

sentences.it: Non preoccuparti, ti aiuto io a traslocare la settimana prossima.
sentences.en: Don't worry, I'll help you move next week.
alternatives: Do not worry, I will help you move next week.
Don't worry, I'll help you move house next week.
Don't worry, I will help you move next week.
sentences.hint: decisione spontanea: will — don't worry, help, move, next week

sentences.it: Ritiro io le chiavi dal padrone di casa.
sentences.en: I'll pick up the keys from the landlord.
alternatives: I will pick up the keys from the landlord.
I'll pick the keys up from the landlord.
sentences.hint: decisione spontanea: will — pick up, keys, landlord

sentences.it: Il furgone arriva alle otto di mattina.
sentences.en: The van is coming at eight in the morning.
alternatives: The van's coming at eight in the morning.
The van is coming at 8 in the morning.
The moving van is coming at eight in the morning.
sentences.hint: present continuous per un programma — van, come, at eight

sentences.it: Domani noleggiamo un furgone per il trasloco.
sentences.en: We're hiring a moving van tomorrow.
alternatives: We are hiring a moving van tomorrow.
Tomorrow we're hiring a moving van.
We're renting a moving van tomorrow.
We are renting a moving van tomorrow.
sentences.hint: present continuous per un programma — hire, moving van, tomorrow

sentences.en: We'll clean the apartment before we leave.
alternatives: We will clean the apartment before we leave.
We'll clean the flat before we leave.
We will clean the flat before we leave.
sentences.hint: will — clean, apartment, before we leave

sentences.it: Lunedì l'agente immobiliare viene per definire tutto.
sentences.en: The estate agent is coming on Monday to finalise everything.
alternatives: The estate agent is visiting on Monday to finalise everything.
The estate agent is coming on Monday to finalize everything.
The estate agent's coming on Monday to finalise everything.
sentences.hint: present continuous per un programma — estate agent, on Monday, finalise

sentences.it: Se il divano è troppo grande, lo venderemo online.
sentences.en: If the sofa is too big, we'll sell it online.
alternatives: If the sofa's too big, we'll sell it online.
If the sofa is too big, we will sell it online.
sentences.hint: if + present simple, will — sofa, too big, sell online

alternatives: I will measure it.

sentences.it: Domani chiamo la compagnia di internet per attivare la connessione.
sentences.en: I'm calling the internet company tomorrow to set up the connection.
alternatives: I am calling the internet company tomorrow to set up the connection.
Tomorrow I'm calling the internet company to set up the connection.
sentences.hint: present continuous per un programma — internet company, set up, connection

sentences.it: Dobbiamo disdire il contratto delle utenze prima di lasciare la vecchia casa.
sentences.en: We need to cancel the utility contract before we leave the old house.
alternatives: We have to cancel the utility contract before we leave the old house.
We need to cancel the utility contract before leaving the old house.
sentences.hint: need to + infinito — cancel, utility contract, leave the old house

sentences.it: Questo trasloco sarà un nuovo inizio per noi.
sentences.en: This move will be a fresh start for us.
alternatives: This move will be a new start for us.

sentences.it: Quando arriviamo etichetteremo tutti gli scatoloni.
sentences.en: We'll label all the boxes when we arrive.
alternatives: We will label all the boxes when we arrive.
When we arrive we'll label all the boxes.
sentences.hint: will + when + present simple — label, boxes, arrive

sentences.it: Hai mai traslocato? Qual è stata la cosa più difficile?
sentences.en: Have you ever moved house? What was the most difficult thing?
alternatives: Have you ever moved? What was the most difficult thing?
Have you ever moved house? What was the hardest thing?
sentences.hint: present perfect con ever, poi past simple — move house, most difficult

sentences.it: Domani faccio ordine nella stanza degli ospiti.
sentences.en: I'm sorting out the spare room tomorrow.
alternatives: I am sorting out the spare room tomorrow.
I'm sorting through the spare room tomorrow.
Tomorrow I'm sorting out the spare room.
sentences.hint: present continuous per un programma — sort out, spare room

vocabulary.example: We're moving house next month.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «move» è muoversi: con la casa diventa «move house», si sposta tutta la casa.

vocabulary.example: The move took all day.
I spent the evening packing boxes.
Label the boxes with the name of each room.
We cleaned the apartment before we left.

vocabulary.it: noleggiare un furgone per il trasloco
vocabulary.example: We hired a moving van for Saturday.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «hire» non è «assumere» qui: con un furgone vuol dire noleggiare.

vocabulary.example: It took two hours to load the van.
My brothers helped us unload the van.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «un-» toglie: load è caricare, unload è scaricare.

vocabulary.example: Don't forget to cancel the utility contract.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «utility» sono le utenze (luce, gas, acqua): pensa a «utile» per la casa.

vocabulary.example: We set up the utility contract online.
We handed over the keys to the new owners.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «hand over»: passare di mano in mano, la mano (hand) passa sopra (over).

vocabulary.example: I'll pick up the keys from the landlord.

vocabulary.it: fare ordine tra le proprie cose
vocabulary.example: I need to sort out my stuff before the move.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «sort» come «sorta»: dividere le cose per tipo.

vocabulary.example: We bought packing materials at the supermarket.
It was sad to leave the old house.
A company arranged the move for us.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «arrange» non è arrangiarsi: è organizzare, sistemare per bene.

vocabulary.example: It took us a month to settle into the new home.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «settle» è sistemarsi, come un uccello che si posa: si posa nella nuova casa.

vocabulary.example: The van is parked outside.
This box is very heavy.
Our landlord lives upstairs.
The estate agent showed us three flats.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «estate» qui non è la stagione: è la proprietà, come «stato» patrimoniale.

vocabulary.example: My parents sleep in the spare room when they visit.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «spare» è di scorta, in più, come la ruota di scorta (spare tyre).

vocabulary.example: We donated our old clothes to charity.
Can you measure the window?
I sold my old bike online.
Moving abroad was a fresh start for her.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «fresh» è fresco: un inizio fresco, appena fatto.

vocabulary.example: We booked a deep clean for the new flat.
vocabulary.mnemonic: «deep» è profondo: una pulizia profonda, a fondo.

vocabulary.example: Moving day is always tiring.
«Pack boxes» is a common collocation.

grammar.title: Le collocazioni del trasloco
grammar.body:
Le **collocazioni** sono parole che in inglese si usano spesso **insieme**. Impararle a coppie aiuta a parlare in modo più naturale.

## Verbo + nome per il trasloco

| Verbo | Nome | Significato |
| --- | --- | --- |
| *pack* / *label* | *boxes* | impacchettare / etichettare gli scatoloni |
| *clean* | *the apartment* | pulire l'appartamento |
| *hire* / *load* / *unload* | *a moving van* | noleggiare / caricare / scaricare un furgone |
| *cancel* / *set up* | *the utility contract* | disdire / attivare il contratto delle utenze |
| *hand over* / *pick up* | *the keys* | consegnare / ritirare le chiavi |
| *sort out* | *the stuff* | fare ordine tra le cose |
| *buy* | *packing materials* | comprare il materiale da imballaggio |
| *leave* | *the old house* | lasciare la vecchia casa |
| *arrange* | *the move* | organizzare il trasloco |
| *settle in* | *the new home* | ambientarsi nella nuova casa |

## Parlare del futuro del trasloco

Per i **programmi già organizzati** si usa il *present continuous*, per le **decisioni prese sul momento** *will* (vedi la lezione «A day trip»):

- *I'm moving house next week.* — Trasloco la settimana prossima (è deciso).
- *Don't worry, I'll help you.* — Non preoccuparti, ti aiuto io (decido ora).

## Domanda di conversazione

- *Have you ever moved house? What was the most difficult thing you had to do?*
